companies.sub: インターネット・ゲーム

relations.text: Redditは2024年3月19日付で、Tencent Cloud Europe B.V.などとの議決権契約を締結している
relations.text_en: Reddit has a voting agreement dated March 19, 2024 with Tencent Cloud Europe B.V. and others

source.label: Reddit 10-K
source.quote: 99.2 Voting Agreement, dated as of March 19, 2024, by and between the Registrant, Tencent Cloud Europe B.V., Jojoba Investment Limited, and the Proxyholder (as defined therein)
source.note: 子会社レベルの契約で、契約書一覧への記載です。
source.note_en: Subsidiary-level agreement; listed in the exhibit index.

relations.text: Sprout Socialの年次報告が、主要SNSの1つとしてRedditとの関係を挙げている
relations.text_en: Sprout Social's annual report lists Reddit among the leading social networks it has strategic relationships with

source.label: Sprout Social 10-K
source.quote: We have cultivated strong, strategic relationships with leading social networks—including Facebook, Instagram, Threads, X (formerly Twitter), Pinterest, LinkedIn, YouTube, Reddit, Tumblr, Bluesky and TikTok.

relations.text: JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A.が管理代理人を務める与信契約(2025年7月1日付の改訂再録版)をRedditが締結している
relations.text_en: Reddit has an amended and restated credit and guarantee agreement dated July 1, 2025 with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as administrative agent

source.label: Reddit 10-K
source.quote: Amended and Restated Credit and Guarantee Agreement, dated July 1, 2025, by and among the Company, as borrower, the guarantors listed therein, the lenders listed therein, and JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., as administrative agent
source.note: 資金調達のみの関係です。

relations.text: スナップの年次報告が、レディットを競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Names Reddit as a competitor in its annual report

source.label: Snap 10-K
source.quote: Our competitors range from smaller or newer companies to larger, more established companies such as Alphabet (including Google and YouTube), Apple, ByteDance ( TikTok and affiliated joint ventures), Kakao, LINE, Meta (including Facebook, Instagram, Threads, and WhatsApp), Naver (including Snow), Pinterest, Reddit, Tencent, and X (formerly Twitter).

relations.text: ピンタレストの年次報告が、レディットを競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Names Reddit as a competitor in its annual report

source.label: Pinterest 10-K
source.quote: Competitors such as Amazon, Meta (including Facebook, Instagram, Threads and MetaAI), Google (including Gemini, Lens and YouTube), OpenAI (including ChatGPT), Snap, Reddit, TikTok and X, many of which are larger and have significantly greater financial and human resources, offer users engaging content and commerce opportunities through

relations.text: レディットの年次報告が、競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Named as a competitor in Reddit’s annual report

source.label: Reddit 10-K
source.quote: • For Peer-to-peer Commerce —Facebook Marketplace, Nextdoor, Craigslist, Poshmark, Etsy, and Roblox.
